description: Audit metadata identifying the implementation that actually produced a preview render. This metadata records implementation origin and safety behavior; it never grants authority. Consumers determine authority only from an applicable publisher-origin preview_provider delegation.

export.description: Renderer export or entry-point name used for this render.

rendering_origin.description: Informational implementation origin copied from the selected route. It does not grant authority.

tracking_suppressed.description: True only when the produced output cannot initiate impression, click, billing, conversion, viewability, or asset-fetch side effects. Renderers that retain any remote asset URL or navigation MUST emit false.

version.description: Exact semantic version of the renderer implementation.

title: Preview Renderer Metadata
